---
title: Preview your app
description: Use Preview on the right to see the web app as it is built.
sidebar:
  order: 7
---

When the project includes a web app, the right pane defaults to **Preview**. While the AI is **Building**, the pane may show **Building your app…** or **Opening your app…**, then the clickable UI.

If preview fails, the pane explains **Preview failed to start.** or a timeout. Retry from that message — you do not need to leave the project.

What you see in Preview is the current draft, not the published version. To give other people a stable URL, [publish](/build/go-live/).
